dataset.name: Parking Birmingham
dataset.creator: Daniel Stolfi
dataset.citation: Stolfi, D. (2017). Parking Birmingham [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C51K5Z
dataset.changes: Readings were deduplicated, cleaned, converted to occupancy rates and aligned to half-hour slots. See docs/DATA.md.

splits.unit: calendar date of the forecast origin; targets stay in the same split

default_model_rule: Lowest validation RMSE. The test period played no part in this choice.

seasonal_profile.label: Historical average for the same slot and day type

features.mean_rate: Average occupancy across all observed slots
features.morning_rise: Average occupancy at 11:00 minus average at 08:00
features.afternoon_fall: Average occupancy at 13:00 minus average at 16:30
features.day_to_day_variation: Standard deviation of daily average occupancy

clusters.label: Higher average occupancy, quieter at weekends
Lower average occupancy, similar across the week

clusters.caveat: Labels describe measured occupancy patterns only. The dataset does not state what a car park is used for, so no land-use or purpose is implied.
